title: Taylor Swift Gives Teary-Eyed Thanks to Family At Songwriters Hall of Fame Induction: “I’ll Never Be Able to Express My Gratitude”
summary: "If I look back at my entire 23-year career in music, the ups and downs, the industry battles, the trials and tribulations… songwriting was the easiest thing I ever did,” Swift said in her speech at the event in New York.
